cards.text: Someone else has clearly had the same idea about this patch of ground, and unlike you, they've brought company.

cards.speaker: Rival
cards.text: "Friendly notice. We're taking an interest in the good plot round here. A hundred quid says our interest fades. Your call."
He says "friendly" the way people say it right before it stops being true.

choices.label: Pay them off (£100)
choices.result_text: He pockets it without counting it, which is somehow more insulting than if he had. "Pleasure doing business," he says, in the tone of a man who has never once meant that sentence.

choices.label: Let them have it
choices.result_text: You shrug and walk off. By the time you're back, someone else's flag is already in the ground on the best plot going.

cards.text: London rewards neither generosity nor spite. It just carries on.
